reason: Nobody I know is using it. It's a new company with no customers, and I don't put my bookings and drivers on anything until another operator at the association tells me it works. On top of that I haven't got the time to learn a new system and run two side by side for 60 days.
objection: No operator has vouched for it, so I'd be the guinea pig. If it falls over in the middle of school excursion season, it's my business that's stuffed, not theirs.
would_change_my_mind: An operator I know, at the bus association or nearby, telling me they've run it for a few months and it actually saves them time.
